    id: "cc-5",

// ── PROJECTS ──────────────────────────────────
export const projects = [
  {
    id: "proj-1",
    name: "Kenyatta National Hospital — Vaccine Cold Room Upgrade",
    location: "Nairobi County, Kenya",
    type: "Medical Cold Chain",
    year: "2023",
    challenge:
      "Aging single-phase cold rooms were failing WHO PQS standards, placing 2.4 million annual vaccine doses at risk of temperature excursion.",
    solution:
      "Designed and installed redundant pharmaceutical-grade cold rooms with IoT continuous monitoring, generator backup integration, and full IQ/OQ/PQ validation documentation.",

    type: "Mortuary Infrastructure",
    year: "2022",
    challenge:
      "Insufficient mortuary capacity and outdated body storage failing county health authority standards and unable to serve the growing coastal population.",
    solution:
      "Designed and installed a 40-body 316L stainless steel mortuary system complete with refrigeration, ventilation, fume extraction, and a dedicated autopsy suite.",

    year: "2022",
    challenge:
      "No dedicated histopathology facility serving a catchment population of over 1 million people across the Nyanza region, forcing patients to travel to Nairobi for diagnosis.",

      "Fully equipped and commissioned histopathology laboratory including tissue processors, embedding centres, rotary microtomes, cryostats, and automated staining systems.",

    location: "Nakuru County, Kenya",
    type: "Medical Cold Chain",
    year: "2023",
    challenge:
      "Blood bank lacking temperature-validated storage, placing blood product safety at risk and failing KNBS inspection requirements.",
    solution:
      "Supplied and installed dedicated blood bank refrigerators, platelet agitators, plasma freezers, and a fully integrated monitoring and alarm system with 21 CFR Part 11 data logging.",

    tags: ["Blood Bank", "Cold Chain", "Medical"],
    imagePlaceholderClass: "img-proj-1",
